lines.text: The Servant will be highly exalted, though many were appalled at His disfigured appearance.
Prophets will shut their mouths because of Him, for they will see what they were not told.
He was despised and rejected, a man of sorrows, yet He was pierced for our transgressions.
He did not open His mouth, and He was led like a goat to the slaughter.
He was assigned a grave with the wicked, yet He bore the sin of many.
